# Services
🛠️ Full-Stack Web Application Development
Present this as your flag-ship end-to-end service for clients who need complete web applications built from the ground up.

Custom Web App Development: End-to-end design, development, and deployment tailored to business requirements.

Modern Front-End Development: Responsive, dynamic user interfaces using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.

Database & Back-End Integration: Seamless connectivity between front-end UI and back-end logic.

Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) & SPAs: Fast, responsive single-page applications optimized for desktop and mobile browsers.

🔷 Enterprise .NET Development
Highlight this for business clients looking for reliable, scalable Microsoft ecosystem solutions.

ASP.NET Core Web APIs & Web Apps: Building high-performance, secure backend services and enterprise web portals.

Microservices Architecture: Modular .NET service development for high-availability systems.

Legacy System Migration: Upgrading older .NET Framework applications to modern .NET (Core / 8+).

Cloud & Azure Integration: Cloud-native .NET app deployment, Azure Functions, and cloud storage setup.

☕ Robust Java Development
Position this as your solution for high-concurrency, enterprise-grade backends and enterprise software.

Java Enterprise & Spring Boot Development: Secure, scalable server-side development using Spring Boot and Spring MVC.

RESTful API & Microservices Engineering: Building clean, lightweight, and well-documented API architectures.

ORM & Database Management: Expert integration using Hibernate/JPA with PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server.

Performance Tuning & Refactoring: Optimizing slow Java backends and refactoring monolithic codebases.

🔌 API Development & System Integration
Target clients who already have an app but need connections to other services or a back-end.

Custom REST & GraphQL APIs: Building secure endpoints for web, mobile, and third-party consumers.

Third-Party Integrations: Payment gateway setup (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal), OAuth authentication, and external service APIs.

Database Design & Optimization: Schema design, SQL query optimization, and data migration.

🧪 QA Testing, Maintenance & Support
Essential for retaining clients on monthly retainers or ongoing projects.

Automated & Manual Testing: Comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using Selenium, JUnit, and NUnit.

Bug Fixes & System Maintenance: Continuous monitoring, performance optimization, and regular updates.

Security & Vulnerability Patching: Hardening web applications against common web vulnerabilities (OWASP standards).
